## The roadmap

Role-based ("Trades contractor", "Content channel"), jurisdiction-based ("Starting a business
in <country/state/province>"), strategy-based ("Holding company + operating company"), or
skill-based ("GST/HST from zero")? Who is it for, in one sentence?

## Jurisdiction

Which country / state / province the rules come from. If it is new to the repo, say so — the
first PR also extends the `authority` / `jurisdiction` types.

## Tiers

The columns, in order, one line each.

## Nodes (20–40)

For each: tier · plain-English title · one paragraph · at least one official source with the
day you read it. Nodes are proposed here first; the roadmap is built from merged nodes.

## What it is NOT

What you deliberately left out, and why (relevance, not completeness).
